rationale: The Latin anchors ictus, plaga, and percussio all denote a blow, stroke, or lash — i.e., the act of striking or a wound from a blow — not any kind of visual stripe or marking. None of the offered synsets capture this sense; all candidates refer to a colored band, military insignia, a category, or a visual marking, none of which correspond to the "stroke/blow/lash" meaning anchored by the Latin.
